devdoc.details: This contract manages a list of addresses and has a simple CRUD

addToBlocklist(address).details: Fails if the address was already blocklisted

batchAddToBlocklist(address[]).details: Fails if at least one of the addresses was already blocklisted

params.accounts: [] The list of addresses to add

batchRemoveFromBlocklist(address[]).details: Fails if at least one of the addresses was not blocklisted

params.accounts: [] The list of addresses to remove

getFullList().return: array The list of currently blocklisted addresses

isBlocklisted(address).return: bool True if the address is blocklisted

isOwner().details: Returns true if the caller is the current owner.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeFromBlocklist(address).details: Fails if the address was not blocklisted

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner.      * NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: Blocklist

addToBlocklist(address).notice: Adds an address to the blocklist

batchAddToBlocklist(address[]).notice: Adds many addresses to the blocklist at once

batchRemoveFromBlocklist(address[]).notice: Removes many addresses from the blocklist at once

getFullList().notice: Fetches the list of all blocklisted addresses

isBlocklisted(address).notice: Consults whether an address is blocklisted

removeFromBlocklist(address).notice: Removes an address from the blocklist
